title: Dishes of the world
intro: Which country is each dish from? Origins follow Wikidata, and many foods are shared across borders, so these are single-country origins only.

questions.prompt: Which country is Kemalpaşa dessert from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Türkiye as the country of origin of Kemalpaşa dessert.
Wikidata gives Italy as the country of origin of Sardenaira.
Wikidata gives Indonesia as the country of origin of klappertaart.
Wikidata gives Chile as the country of origin of pantruca.
Wikidata gives Republic of Korea as the country of origin of ramyeon.
Wikidata gives Indonesia as the country of origin of Buntil.

questions.prompt: Which country is Scacciata PAT from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Italy as the country of origin of Scacciata PAT.
Wikidata gives Benin as the country of origin of Amiwô.
Wikidata gives South Africa as the country of origin of chakalaka.
Wikidata gives France as the country of origin of Cotriade.
